utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Hannah speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I’m Harriet Carmichael. I’ve been charged unarranged overdraft fees and I’m really unhappy about it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’m sorry you’ve had that experience, Harriet. I’ll look into it with you. Before we discuss your account, could you tell me your full name and date of birth, please?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. And the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks, that’s verified. Could you tell me a bit more about what’s happened?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: There are three fees, £15 each, taken on 18 September. I went over my limit briefly, but I didn’t expect to be charged that much. I tried calling last week and didn’t get a clear answer.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can understand why that’s frustrating, especially when you’ve already tried to get an explanation. I’ll review the charges and the previous contact.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I want the fees back. It doesn’t seem fair.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can’t promise what the outcome will be, but I can make sure your concerns are formally looked into. I’m logging this as a complaint about the unarranged overdraft fees and the explanation you received.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll take ownership of the complaint and send it to our complaints team today, with the details you’ve given me. They’ll investigate and send you a full written response within 8 weeks.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Will you let me know if you need anything else?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Yes. I’ll check the complaint record tomorrow and contact you by phone if we need any more information. Otherwise, the complaints team will write to you with their response within that 8-week timeframe.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: So, I’m logging your complaint about the three fees and the earlier explanation, I’m sending it to the team today, and I’ll check in tomorrow if anything further is needed. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You’re welcome, Harriet. I’m sorry again for the frustration, and I’ll make sure it’s passed on today.
